item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a standalone 2024 manifesto or doctrinal program document that is more authoritative than these speeches and press releases. Most of the evidence is inferred from repeated public messaging plus later implementation or repression, so the “ideology” is better read as a pragmatic reform package than as a fully formalized governing doctrine.","evidence":[{"title":"Text of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s New Year Address to the Nation","publisher":"State House","date":"January 1, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/text-of-president-bola-ahmed-tinubus-new-year-address-to-the-nation/","summary":"He set out a specific 2024 agenda: revamp the economy, restore security, boost agriculture, increase productivity, protect the poor, and deliver a living wage. He also framed equal opportunity and cross-party cooperation as part of the national project.","question_ids":["8B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Signs 2024 of Renewed Hope, Directs MDAs to Provide Monthly Performance Reports","publisher":"State House","date":"January 1, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-signs-2024-of-renewed-hope-directs-mdas-to-provide-monthly-performance-reports/","summary":"He listed defense/security, job creation, macro-stability, investment optimization, human capital, poverty reduction, and social security as the core budget priorities, and said the presidency was building a rules-based society where no one is above the law.","question_ids":["8B.1"]},{"title":"FULL TEXT: Tinubu speaks on economic reforms, new minimum wage in Democracy Day speech","publisher":"TheCable","date":"June 12, 2024","url":"https://www.thecable.ng/full-text-tinubu-speaks-on-economic-reforms-new-minimum-wage-in-democracy-day-speech/","summary":"He defended his reform program while openly acknowledging hardship, and said government had negotiated with labour rather than defaulting to arrests or repression. This is the clearest direct evidence of a stated reform doctrine being tied to later action.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.8"]},{"title":"With good governance and commitment, we must overcome old subsidy beneficiaries","publisher":"State House","date":"March 15, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/with-good-governance-and-commitment-we-must-overcomee-old-subsidy-benificiaries-president-tinubu/","summary":"Tinubu framed subsidy reform as a way to stop treasury abuse and fund student loans, consumer credit, and targeted social welfare using NIN-linked relief. That is a concrete policy program, not just vague rhetoric.","question_ids":["8B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu establishes comprehensive economic coordination and planning system for Nigeria","publisher":"State House","date":"March 27, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-establishes-comprehensive-economic-coordination-and-planning-system-for-nigeria/","summary":"He created PECC/EET structures centered on the finance minister and CBN governor, with economists and private-sector figures, which signals a technocratic, coordination-heavy governing style.","question_ids":["8B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu: Live Up To Your Expectation As Public Trust For Accountability","publisher":"State House","date":"July 6, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-live-up-to-your-expectation-as-public-trust-for-accountability/","summary":"He said public institutions are not personal enterprises and emphasized merit and accountability. This is explicit governing ideology language about how power should be used.","question_ids":["8B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu: I have no Cabal or Sponsors to Compensate","publisher":"State House","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-i-have-no-cabal-or-sponsors-to-compensate/","summary":"He denied owing any cabal or sponsors, described his campaign as self-sponsored, and said he was reworking welfare delivery to the ward level while pointing to student loans, consumer credit, and minimum-wage increases. This reveals both an anti-patronage self-presentation and a concrete distributive program.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.10"]},{"title":"Fact-checking president Tinubu's claims about Nigeria's economic successes in his Independence Day speech","publisher":"Africa Check","date":"October 3, 2024","url":"https://africacheck.org/fact-checks/reports/fact-checking-president-tinubus-claims-about-nigerias-economic-successes-his","summary":"Tinubu’s October 1 success claims were partly wrong: Africa Check found the $30 billion FDI claim false, the reserve claim mostly false, and other claims unproven or misleading. That weakens any reading of a consistently disciplined or fully honest public program.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.8"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Protesters Charged with Treason","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"September 6, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/06/nigeria-protesters-charged-treason","summary":"HRW reported that protesters were charged with treason and kept from lawyers, which suggests that the administration’s revealed goal in crisis was not just policy execution but also intimidation and control of dissent.","question_ids":["8B.1"]},{"title":"Nigeria charges protesters with treason, inciting military","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"September 2, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigeria-charges-protesters-with-treason-inciting-military/2249248/","summary":"Reuters reported the state framed protesters as destabilizers and mutineers. That is direct counterevidence to a cleanly democratic or purely reformist governing posture.","question_ids":["8B.1"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Police used excessive force to violently quash #EndBadGovernance protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"November 28, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/nigeria-police-used-excessive-force-to-violently-quash-endbadgovernance-protests/","summary":"Amnesty said police killed at least 24 people, detained more than 1,200, and used live ammunition during the August crackdown. Later action contradicted the earlier pro-accountability rhetoric and shows a strong regime-preservation response.","question_ids":["8B.1"]}]}
